name: Staff Pick- Give Wine
tagline: Give the gift of great wine this year - choose your color, set your budget and how many bottles you want to send!
description:
Not sure what to get someone this year? Got a big wine fan in your life? Need to send something to some great clients of yours?

Don't worry - we've got you covered!

Select your budget, how many bottles you want to send, and any stylistic preferences, and we'll do the rest!

name: The DeLaurenti Wine Flight
description: The full flight people...Our new Red Wine, Oregon Pinot Noir, Chianti Classico, Organic Prosecco, Roero Arneis, and our Rosato. A wine for every occasion & a GREAT gift!

name: Bordeaux - Left Bank/Right Bank
description:
Let our staff take you on a micro-tour of Bordeaux. In this set, you'll find two luxurious examples of a Left Bank and Right Bank Bordeaux Rouge. Highlighting the unique soil types and varietal focus of the various sub-regions on either side of the Dordogne, this collection makes a perfect gift or someone just discovering the region, or any wine enjoyer that needs an easy set of perfect holiday reds.

*AVAILABLE FOR STORE PICK UP OR IN-STATE SHIPPING ONLY

name: The Four B's
description:
All right, here's the deal... You've got an extra special person in your life who's just getting into wine, or maybe even just discovering Italian wine. This set is a snapshot of some of the most-storied and prestigious wine regions on the Italian penninsula.

In here, you'll find one distinguished example of a Barolo DOCG, Barbaresco DOCG, Brunello di Montalcino DOCG, and a Barbera d'Alba DOC or Barbera d'Asti DOCG.

This set not only makes a great introduction to some of the most reputable Italian red wines but also makes a great gift for someone who's already a fan!

*AVAILABLE FOR STORE PICK UP OR IN-STATE SHIPPING ONLY

name: DeLaurenti Prosecco
description: Our very own prosecco from just outside Trieste. Crisp, dry and delicious. There is no prosecco season - this wine is good 12 months a year!

name: DeLaurenti Red Wine
description: Our newest Washington red blend has arrived! This everyday red is made in the great state of Washington with Italian roots. Crafted in the same way as the great Super Tuscan Tignanello, it consists of 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot & 5% Cabernet Franc. The result is a lush, accessible wine with flavors of dark fruit, baking spice & subtle toasted oak. Great on its own, with grilled meats and pasta. Or, with its convenient screw top, its the perfect picnic wine!

name: DeLaurenti Rosato 750ml
description: A new batch of DeLaurenti Rosato has made it to our shelves! This rose is reminiscent of the roses of Provence, despite being entirely Tuscan Sangiovese. Refreshing, dry, and light with a slightly tart berry finish. This wine will transport you to a sunny afternoon on a breezy Mediterranean beach, no matter what time of year you pop the cork!

name: Delaurenti Pinot Noir
description: When we decided to bring in another PNW wine under our private label, we knew we wanted it to be Pinot Noir. An elegant, medium-bodied red that would be perfect for any season, and ready for your dinner table any night of the week. Single-vineyard fruit from the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon, aged in new and used French oak for 18 months, and really fun to drink!

name: The Pasta Course
tagline: Serves 4 with leftovers once, or 2 twice!
description:
This is a no brainer gift for anyone...including you. Can't take them to dinner? Don't want to take them to dinner? Give them an easy dinner instead!

The description of this item is pretty self-explanatory - DeLaurenti Fresh Egg Linguine (or Tirrena linguine if shipping ground), DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa, a hunk of Parmiggiano-Reggiano & a bottle of Italian red wine. Serves 2 twice, or up to 4 with some left overs. Add another bottle of wine if just one won't do!

name: DeLaurenti Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG
description: Our very own Chianti! Hailing from organic vineyards in the town of Montepulciano, this wine is your go-to for any and all pizza, pasta with red sauce, or anything on the grill. Mellow tannins and gorgeous, earthy, red berry notes on the nose. Our Chianti was sourced with our own dinner tables in mind- bring it home to yours today!
